dog.description_text:
Meet Pixie!

This tiny girl recently joined the Every Last One Rescue family! At just 30 lbs and around 1 year old, Pixie is a petite little lady with a whole lot of life ahead of her.

She's just getting settled into foster care, and we can't wait to learn more about her personality as she decompresses and starts to feel at home.

Stay tuned for more on sweet Pixie!
dog.name: Pixie
